annotations.title: Compare asserted values with a lease

description: Compare values another document asserts (an estoppel, rent roll or offering memo, mapped by you to predicates) with verified lease facts from doc_abstract_lease or doc_verify_facts. Each asserted value comes back match, mismatch (with the differing fields), not_in_lease, or ambiguous_in_lease (two current lease facts disagree), with the controlling lease citation (document, page, quote). Values compare exactly as JSON: numbers by value, strings exactly (a name written differently is a mismatch), and for an object only the fields you assert. Facts another fact supersedes are ignored. When the lease fact is an extracted fact whose quote does not confirm part of its value (a true/false value, an enum), the result lists those parts in lease_not_checked. The lease facts must pass fact_validate; FactLot does not re-read the lease, so pass the facts its document tools returned.

asserted.description: Values another document states (an estoppel, a rent roll, an OM), mapped to predicates.

predicate.description: Predicate of the asserted value, e.g. lease.expiration_date.

value.description: The asserted value in the predicate's shape (YYYY-MM-DD dates, plain numbers, decimal rates). For an object, only the fields given are compared.

lease_facts.description: Verified lease facts: the facts from doc_abstract_lease (or doc_verify_facts). Facts another fact supersedes are ignored.

items.description: A FactLot fact, as doc_verify_facts returned it.
